## Notes

- plus=tec: add the Terrain Effects Chart cost for the hex
- cpa_fraction: cost is that fraction of the unit's CPA (1 = full CPA), added to any fixed cost and plus
- Free actions may still restrict later CP spending (SPI 6.3 note)
- Cross-checked row by row against the chart sheet's Capability Point Expenditure Summary (archive.org jp2 95, and the 300 dpi community scan scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p1): 0 of 36 rows differ from the values transcribed from the 6.3 rules text
